features.label: Dorsiflexion assist
features.text: Dynamic posterior frame lifts the foot and limits plantar flexion for improved ground clearance.

features.label: Supination control strap
features.text: Elastic strap yields to pressure and guides the foot out of a supinated position.

features.label: Wear it day or night
features.text: Secures the foot in a neutral position for walking or resting support.

features.label: Low profile under shoes
features.text: Slim posterior shell and padded calf cuff fit comfortably inside closed footwear.

features.label: Anti-slip sole pad
features.text: Textured rubber pad attaches to the sole for safe indoor wear over a sock.

features.label: Simple to clean
features.text: Wipe the frame with a damp cloth and hand wash the pads in warm water.

features.label: Heat adjustable frame
features.text: A qualified fitter can reshape the frame thermoplastically with gentle heat.

features.text: Qualifies for tax-advantaged health spending accounts.

features.label: Pdac approved l1930
features.text: Ankle foot orthosis, plastic or other material, prefabricated, includes fitting and adjustment.

measurement: Use the wearer's normal US shoe size and read the men and women columns separately, because the ranges differ. Confirm the fit inside the closed shoe the wearer will actually use and account for the allowable effective heel height. If the wearer falls between 2 sizes, choose the larger size and check that the heel seats fully in the shell. The first fitting and application must be carried out by qualified personnel. If needed, a fitter can reshape the frame thermoplastically with gentle heat; reforming in cold conditions or above 80 C (176 F) is not permitted. If the orthosis will be worn indoors without shoes, lightly sand the heel area and attach the supplied rubber pad with the double sided adhesive tape. Attach the calf pad using the supplied hook and loop tabs and attach the pad to the shin strap before first use. Wear the orthosis only with a closed shoe for full stabilization, and never on a slippery surface without shoes. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
